backtest.disclaimer: SEM+ predicts next-year run prevention out of sample. IP, GS and innings per start are workload context, not rate.

multiyear.note: 3-year SEM+ is FROZEN lab output read verbatim from sem_plus_multiyear_eval.json, as of generated_at, not this board's as_of. Starters who joined the pool since have no value.

war_rate.note: 100 + 10z of eWAR per IP over starters with 20+ IP: 10 points = 1 pool SD, not the HEM+/REM+/SEM+ ratio scale. eWAR: Baseball-Reference run frame, pitching re-priced on FIP, fielding unchanged pending SDR; position players match bWAR except in seasons they also pitched. No shrink, no clamp; blank under 40 IP.
war_rate.adj_note: war_ip_plus_adj shrinks the rate toward the pool rate by sample size (K = pool median IP = 115.7) and re-standardises on the SHRUNK pool. A readability aid for thin samples, not a forward claim: ship gate G2 failed on every pool, and a post-hoc volume control puts most of the shrink gain down to volume. Does NOT reproduce war/ip on the row.

ewar_vintage.note: data/ewar.json rebuilds its live season nightly; completed seasons are frozen byte for byte and re-priced only by a hand build with the runbook cascade.
ewar_vintage.warning: 527 covered player-seasons no longer match the eWAR artifact built 2026-09-24T14:42:01; the served WAR numerator is behind its own frame (rebuild: python tools/build_ewar.py --nightly --write)

multiyear_war_rate.note: The 3-year column is FROZEN lab output read verbatim from war_rate_plus_multiyear_eval.json, as of generated_at, not this board's as_of. Starters who joined the pool since have no value.

z_contact_pct.per: swings at pitches in the zone

swstr_pct.per: pitches (whiffs per swing times swings per pitch)

savant_custom.use: display only; no model reads these columns

team_basis.label: pitching 2026
team_basis.note: The club MLB's transaction feed lists today, on the charts and in team totals, so a traded player's whole season counts for his new club. Rows with no club (0) are left out of team totals.

roster_filter.scope: the constructed rotation ladder ONLY; Rotation+ and the other aggregates stay on the full season pool
roster_filter.on_failure: a failed fetch filters nothing rather than blanking the charts

team_war.note: team_war is the sum of the club's board rows' pit eWAR, summed UNROUNDED and rounded once; team_war_n is the rows summed, a row whose own eWAR cell is withheld for a zero denominator included. A club with no covered row carries no value. Same club basis as the Team column (see team_basis).

two_way.note: two-way players (feed position TWP) enter the starter pool, the rotations and starters[] like any primary pitcher who passes the true-starter filter (owner decision 2026-09-11); `mlbam` lists the ones on the board, `not_on_board` the two-way lines the filter kept off it

two_way_card_only.note: retired 2026-09-11: two-way players are on the starter board itself, so their cards read starters[]
